title: TRE 2.0 (2023) · Class 9–10 Computer · Series A
subject: BPSC TRE PYQ
topic: Complete official question booklet of the BPSC Teacher Recruitment Exam 2.0 for Secondary (Class 9–10) Computer teacher, held on 8 December 2023. Part I Language (English 1–8, Hindi 9–30, qualifying), Part II General Studies (31–70) and Part III Computer (71–150): computer fundamentals, C++ and OOP, data structures, DBMS and SQL, Boolean logic and networking.
description: All 150 questions of booklet series A exactly as printed, taken from the booklet BPSC itself published, with answers from the BPSC final answer key of 26 December 2023. Questions 80, 82, 83 and 85 were deleted by BPSC and score as correct whatever you mark. Every question has five options: A to C plus 'More than one of the above' and 'None of the above'. Part I is qualifying only in the real exam.
